claim: Knokke-Heist's cycling node network connects to walking/cycling paths from De Panne to the Bruges countryside and the Netherlands, with the sea dyke being the longest cycling path in town; signature routes include the 52 km Maerlantroute through former peatlands and the Riante Polderroute toward the Dutch border, plus Route West (13.3 km) in Duinbergen/Heist and Route East (10 km) around Knokke.
quote: the 52 kilometre Maerlantroute through former peat lands and the Riante Polderroute through the countryside near the Dutch border. Route West (13.3km) in Duinbergen and Heist and Route East (10km) in the area of Knokke

claim: The Flemish fietsknooppunten system lets riders plan routes by chaining numbered junction nodes; NodeMapp offers a 'Node mode' that sticks to the network and an 'Offgrid mode' to deviate, with routes calculated in real time.
quote: With Node mode you can only plan routes on the node network, in Offgrid mode you can deviate from the node network.

claim: The Damse Vaart Canal loop from Knokke is among the most popular road cycling routes in the area at roughly 81 km / 3h27, following the tree-lined canal between Knokke/Sluis and Bruges through polder landscape.
quote: Cycle Path Along the Canal – Damse Vaart Canal loop from Knokke, a 50.3 miles (81.0 km) trail that takes 3 hours 27 minutes to complete

claim: The LF1 North Sea Route is a 150 km signed long-distance path running from Oost-Cappel on the French border to Sluis on the Dutch border, passing through Damme and the West-Flemish polders close to Knokke.
quote: 150 km... runs from the French-Belgian border in Oost-Cappel to the Belgian-Dutch border in Sluis... flirts with the coast and leads you through a network of vast polders and typical West-Flemish villages

claim: The Damse Vaart canal is a 15 km waterway between Sluis (NL) and Bruges, with Damme sitting about 5 km / 7 km ride from Bruges; this is the spine of the classic Knokke-Damme-Bruges flat cycle.
quote: The Damse Vaart is a 15 kilometer long canal between Sluis and Bruges

claim: Fietsverhuur Knokke on the Zeedijk rents city bikes, e-bikes and cargo bikes for day trips along the seafront and polders.
quote: Bicycle rental Knokke-Heist... city bikes, e-bikes, and cargo bikes on the Zeedijk

claim: Fietsen Mike rents bikes, e-bikes and gocarts from the seafront in Knokke-Heist (Albertstrand), a convenient pickup point for Zwin and dyke rides.
Knokke Sea-bike offers bicycle rentals paired with local route advice.
Rent my Bike operates a rental outlet on the Knokke-Heist Zeedijk.

The Royal Belgian Sailing Club runs IKO-certified kitesurf schools at Beachclub Duinbergen and at Het Zoute, with a 4-step group course (≈3 hours each step) priced at €500 as a voucher, lessons running between 3 and 7 Beaufort, and equipment rental for experienced riders.
quote: A complete 4-step group course costs €500 when purchased as a voucher package... Lessons require minimum wind conditions of 3 Beaufort and maximum 7 Beaufort... Instructors hold IKO (International Kiteboarding Organization) certification

claim: Kitesurf Belgium / Surf and Fly Duinbergen is a long-running reference kite and wingfoil school in Knokke, with conditions sheltered by the nearby port of Zeebrugge that yield minimal waves and current — ideal for learners.
quote: the nearby port of Zeebrugge, the location offers unique conditions with minimal waves and current, making it an ideal learning environment for kitesurfing

claim: From 16 October to 15 March riders can use the entire Knokke-Heist beach; from 15 March to 15 October horses are restricted to the Het Zoute section east of the easternmost watersports concession, with low tide being the prime window. Stables Ponderosa (Kalverkeetdijk 148) and Zoute Stables (De Vrede 1) offer guided beach rides for all levels.
quote: From October 16 to March 15, you can ride anywhere on the beach. From March 15 to October 15, you can only take your horse to the beach in the Het Zoute area, which is to the east of the eastern-most water sports club concession.

claim: Surfers Paradise (Appelzakstraat, between the dunes near the Zwin) offers windsurf, surf, kitesurf and SUP; Beachclub Anemos at Zeedijk-Duinbergen 300z adds kiting; both are the principal watersports concessions on the Knokke-Heist beach.
quote: Surf Club Surfers Paradise... Appelzakstraat, Knokke-Heist... windsurf, surf, kitesurf, or stand up... Beachclub Anemos... Zeedijk-Duinbergen 300z, Duinbergen... kiting

claim: Surfers Paradise rents SUPs and kayaks alongside windsurf and kitesurf gear and is the main on-beach hub for non-motorised watersports rentals on the Knokke side.
quote: Verhuur- en watersportlessen toegelaten! - Surfers Paradise

claim: Land/sand yachting (strandzeilen) on the Belgian coast is concentrated at De Panne (Royal Sand Yacht Club) and De Haan (Windhaan vzw) rather than at Knokke itself — Knokke beachgoers wanting strandzeilen typically drive west along the coast.

Knokke-Heist's official 'sportstranden' (sports beaches) operate from Wednesday 1 July to Friday 28 August 2026, the window when beach-based sand yachting, beach volleyball and other guided activities are programmed by the municipality.
quote: sportstranden (sports beaches) are open from Wednesday 1 July to Friday 28 August 2026
